title: Dynamic Network Analysis of Negative Emotions and DSM-5 Posttraumatic Stress Disorder Symptom Clusters During Conflict
limitations: - Limited sample size; - Focus on a specific conflict context; - Linear models assumed; - No formal test of centrality differences; - Limited generalizability to other trauma types
notes: The study used ESM with smartphone data collection. The code for analysis is available in supplementary materials. The data are not publicly available. The study was not preregistered.
